ep2-absurdist-1.speaker: Clancy
ep2-absurdist-1.text: You come on, times a klobexia!

ep2-absurdist-3.speaker: Clancy
ep2-absurdist-3.text: I don't know. I made it up.

ep2-phil-1.speaker: Clancy
ep2-phil-1.text: My first question to you is, um, are you worried? Because it seems like we're all about to die.

ep2-phil-2.speaker: Annie
ep2-phil-2.text: Hmm... It does feel that way, but I've actually had a lot of deaths in my life.

ep2-phil-3.speaker: Clancy
ep2-phil-3.text: The information you're talking about, acknowledging death is an inevitable part of...

ep2-phil-4.speaker: Annie
ep2-phil-4.text: Yeah, it's so freeing to accept it.

ep2-phil-5.speaker: Clancy
ep2-phil-5.text: Do you ever think, 'Well, wait! Maybe if I encountered this early on, I wouldn't have been such a great writer'?

ep2-phil-6.speaker: Annie
ep2-phil-6.text: I felt terror that if I stopped drinking, I would never write again, because I needed the misery.

ep2-conclusion.speaker: Annie
ep2-conclusion.text: Yeah, and then you know what comes out? New life.
